articles.title: Dolphins' Chop Robinson, after fifth concussion, to wear Guardian Cap
articles.summary: Miami Dolphins edge rusher Chop Robinson revealed his latest concussion was the fifth of his career. In response, he plans to begin wearing a Guardian Cap during games to actively prevent future head injuries. This decision underscores growing concerns over player safety and concussion protocols in professional sports, highlighting an individual athlete's proactive step towards long-term health.
